ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with low-intensity (black) pixels dominating the central 60% of the surface and high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels concentrated in the distal 20% of both lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity zones on the outer distal regions of both lobes; the right lobe contains a larger, more defined white region compared to the left. Central region and peduncle interface are characterized by a solid low-intensity black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped notch with a sharp convergence point; estimated internal angle of approximately 35 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations visible across the entire trailing edge; prominence of jagged peaks is higher on the inner curve of the right lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature following a standard fluke sweep, terminating in sharp, slightly upward-tilted lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible high-intensity circular clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) located at both the far-left and far-right lateral tips. Two isolated circular white points are visible near the central peduncle area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant vertical and diagonal dark linear streaks (rake marks) cutting through the high-intensity white zone on the right lobe. Fainter, less numerous linear disruptions visible on the distal left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on the right lobe; significant barnacle-related scarring and cluster formations on the marginal tips of both lobes.
